detail.question: Quels sont les dix produits les plus vendus, en nombre d'articles ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    oi.product_id AS produit,
    COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categorie,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles_vendus,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM entrepot."order_items" AS oi
LEFT JOIN entrepot."products" AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" AS t
    ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
GROUP BY
    oi.product_id,
    COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
ORDER BY nombre_articles_vendus DESC
LIMIT 10

detail.question: Quelles sont les dix categories de produits qui rapportent le plus, en euros ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    COALESCE(traduction.product_category_name_english, produits.product_category_name) AS categorie,
    ROUND(SUM(articles.price), 2) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM entrepot."order_items" AS articles
JOIN entrepot."products" AS produits
    ON produits.product_id = articles.product_id
LEFT JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" AS traduction
    ON traduction.product_category_name = produits.product_category_name
WHERE produits.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY categorie
ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC
LIMIT 10

        WHEN 0 THEN 'dimanche'

detail.question: Quelles categories de produits ont le panier moyen le plus eleve, avec leur nom en anglais ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH lignes_categorie AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categorie,
        oi.order_id,
        oi.price
    FROM entrepot."order_items" AS oi
    JOIN entrepot."products" AS p
      ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    LEFT JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" AS t
      ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
    WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    categorie AS categorie_anglais,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS nombre_commandes,
    ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS chiffre_affaires,
    ROUND(SUM(price) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS panier_moyen
FROM lignes_categorie
GROUP BY categorie
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) >= 30
ORDER BY panier_moyen DESC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Les vendeurs de quels etats livrent le plus vite ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH livraisons AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        o.order_id,
        s.seller_state AS etat_vendeur,
        date_diff(
            'day',
            TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP),
            TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) AS delai_jours
    FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
    JOIN entrepot."order_items" AS oi
      ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN entrepot."sellers" AS s
      ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    etat_vendeur,
    COUNT(*) AS nb_commandes_livrees,
    ROUND(AVG(delai_jours), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours,
    ROUND(MEDIAN(delai_jours), 2) AS delai_median_jours
FROM livraisons
WHERE delai_jours >= 0
GROUP BY etat_vendeur
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours ASC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Quelle est la note moyenne par categorie de produit, en anglais, pour les categories evaluees au moins cinq cents fois ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH avis_categorie AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        r.review_id,
        r.review_score,
        t.product_category_name_english AS categorie
    FROM entrepot."order_reviews" AS r
    JOIN entrepot."order_items" AS oi
      ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
    JOIN entrepot."products" AS p
      ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" AS t
      ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
)
SELECT
    categorie,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_avis,
    ROUND(AVG(review_score), 3) AS note_moyenne
FROM avis_categorie
GROUP BY categorie
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Y a-t-il des doublons dans la table de geolocalisation ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH doublons AS (
    SELECT
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_state,
        COUNT(*) AS nb_occurrences
    FROM entrepot."geolocation"
    GROUP BY
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_state
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*)                                        AS nb_combinaisons_distinctes,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nb_occurrences > 1)      AS nb_combinaisons_en_double,
    SUM(nb_occurrences)                             AS nb_lignes_total,
    SUM(nb_occurrences) - COUNT(*)                  AS nb_lignes_excedentaires,
    MAX(nb_occurrences)                             AS max_repetitions
FROM doublons
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Quel pourcentage de commandes arrive en retard par rapport a la date estimee ?

detail.question: Le delai de livraison depend-il de l'etat du client ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    c.customer_state AS etat_client,
    COUNT(*) AS nb_commandes_livrees,
    ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP), TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours,
    ROUND(MEDIAN(DATE_DIFF('day', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP), TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))), 2) AS delai_median_jours,
    ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP), TRY_CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS TIMESTAMP))), 2) AS avance_moyenne_vs_estimation_jours
FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
JOIN entrepot."customers" AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours DESC
LIMIT 1000
